cover: Strikes kill eight, a boy of four among them
Four workers die in hotel waste chamber
Displaced short of food and medicine

stories.label: India · Land & livelihood
stories.head: Homes of 640+ families demolished
bullets: Authorities demolished homes of more than 640 Bengali Muslim families on Sunday, officials told Scroll.
The district commissioner says the land is for an industrial park and claims most residents have land elsewhere.
One resident says he has lived there since 1962.

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Strikes despite the ceasefire
bullets: Hospitals say three people, including a four-year-old boy, were killed near a school in Gaza City.
Five police officers were killed in al-Mawasi, Khan Younis.
Israel's military says it struck military operatives, without details.

stories.label: India · Life & safety
stories.head: Deaths in a waste chamber
bullets: Four men died of suspected suffocation late on Saturday in a hotel's food-waste chamber.
Two who tried to rescue them fell ill.
Police are investigating; the state announced ₹4 lakh for each family.

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Aid falls short for the displaced
bullets: Displaced people say food and medicines are running low and disease is spreading.
The state aid commissioner counts about 27,400 displaced; Dabanga reports the figure as families.
She says WFP and other groups are delivering food, cash and hygiene kits.
